name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, SRG Housing Ltd provides loans to Retail customers for construction, repair, renovation or purchase of residential property, and loans against property[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SRG Housing Finance is a leading rural housing finance company, focusing on New-to-Credit, Underserved & Unorganized population. They offer small ticket loans, tailored products, and simplified access to finance through minimal documentation and fast processing. As of FY25, they operated 90 branches across 7 states with an AUM of ₹759 crore

pros: Company's median sales growth is 24.9% of last 10 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.0% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.85%
